record.notes: 2026-10-23: this is a WireGuard VPN with open ports, not an SSH tunnel. 'Every plan is a WireGuard VPN with your own dedicated static public IPv4 in the US'; 'Connect your device with WireGuard and open the TCP or UDP ports you need from the dashboard'. The plan table is the fact the record is missing: Plus USD 2/mo gives 5 ports, 100 GB and 20 Mbps; Pro USD 4/mo gives unlimited ports, 1 TB and 100 Mbps; Ultra USD 10/mo gives 5 TB. So the record's 100 GB is the entry tier, not the ceiling, and UDP is available on every tier.

record.binding_note: The monthly bandwidth allowance (1 TB on the Plus plan) is what runs out first; the 50 Mbps rate caps throughput at about 16 TB a month, above it.
record.limits_note: The allowance is the volume-quota row; the rate is the per-ip-shaping row.
